_readme: TransN (root motion) policy for Meta Knight's Brawl -> Melee clips (tools/mk_anim.py apply_transn_policy).
Same idea as brawl-kirby/tools/anim/transn_policy.json: Brawl clips carry the fighter's travel on TransN and Brawl
consumes it as movement; Melee consumes TransN only on motion rows with flag 0x80000000 (fp->x594_b0: TransN is
zeroed and its per-frame delta fed to physics). On every other row the TransN translation is SHOWN on the model,
so Brawl root motion there slides the model away from the fighter and snaps back when the clip restarts.
default          = rule for a row that is not animation-driven.
anim_driven_rows = rule for a row whose Melee flags have 0x80000000 (MK rule: the engine turns TransN into movement,
so Brawl's travel is kept on every axis - e.g. Shuttle Loop on Kirby's Final Cutter rows).
extras           = rule for MK clips that no Kirby row points to (glide, Drill Rush loop, ...): kept as authored;
whoever adds a row for them re-runs with a policy.
auto  = match vanilla Melee Kirby's clip for the same Melee motion, per axis: keep Brawl's axis if Kirby's TransN
moves or holds an offset (> eps) on it, else strip it (hold Brawl's frame-0 value for the whole clip).
keep / strip = force. overrides: key = Brawl clip name or Melee figatree name; value = 'auto'|'keep'|'strip' or
ledge_floor      = ledge get-up clips whose TransN.y values in [-within, 0) snap to 0: Melee lands a CliffClimb/Attack/Escape
only when TransN.z >= 0 and TransN.y >= 0 (ftCo_CliffClimb_Phys); Brawl's clips rest at y = -0.003.
